    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

        for r, c in cells:
            lines[('diff', r-c)].append((r, c))
            lines[('sum', r+c)].append((r, c))
        for key, line in lines.items():
            if len(line) < 2:
                continue

            # A diagonal line must contain at least two adjacent diagonal cells.
            # (Each cell is uniquely in one diff-line and one sum-line.)

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != background:
                pts[grid[r][c]].append((r, c))
    allpts = [p for cells in pts.values() for p in cells]
    cr = sum(r for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts)
    for color, cells in pts.items():
        # Continue only diagonal arms. Vertical and horizontal pairs are part
        # of the seed motif, not rays.
        lines = defaultdict(list)
        for r, c in cells:
            lines[('diff', r-c)].append((r, c))
            lines[('sum', r+c)].append((r, c))
        for key, line in lines.items():
            if len(line) < 2:
                continue
            line.sort()
            # A diagonal line must contain at least two adjacent diagonal cells.
            # (Each cell is uniquely in one diff-line and one sum-line.)
            if not any(abs(a[0]-b[0]) == 1 for a,b in zip(line, line[1:])): continue
            dr, dc = line[-1][0]-line[0][0], line[-1][1]-line[0][1]
            # Choose the end farther from the seed's center and extrapolate outward.
            ends = (line[0], line[-1])
            dist = [((r-cr)**2+(c-cc)**2) for r,c in ends]
            if dist[0] >= dist[1]:
                r,c = ends[0]; sr,sc = (-dr,-dc)
            else:
                r,c = ends[1]; sr,sc = (dr,dc)
            while 0 <= r+sr < h and 0 <= c+sc < w:
                r,c = r+sr,c+sc
                if out[r][c] == background: out[r][c] = color
    return out
